$comment: Canonical local development identity actors. Single source of truth for the one-shot development bootstrap password and the usernames every dev/smoke script logs in with. Local only: these actors are created by the separate identity-local-bootstrap command/service; the production-capable identity-api never owns this writer. The command mutates only when BTHWANI_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_BOOTSTRAP_AUTHORIZED=true, BTHWANI_RUNTIME_MODE=development, and production authorization is false. Consumers: tools/dev/local-actors.mjs, tools/dev/local-actors.ps1. Drift against the Go bootstrap and runtime env files is enforced by tools/guards/local-dev-actors-gate.mjs.
$workforceProvidersComment: Field agents and captains are NOT bootstrap actors. Workforce owns provider actor creation and always provisions Identity with a server-generated workforce code as the username, so a pre-seeded actor holding the same phone can never be adopted. They are provisioned at runtime by tools/dev/local-workforce-provisioning.mjs, which writes the generated actor ids to .artifacts/local-dev/workforce-actors.json. They authenticate by redeeming an activation code, not by password.
